summary: Deprecate namespace-related fields in Java SDK workflow options (ChildWorkflowOptions, external cancel/signal options) following API-level deprecation due to Temporal Server 1.30.1 disabling cross-namespace operations by default.
userImpact: Users must update code to remove usage of deprecated namespace fields on workflow options before they are removed in future SDK versions.
proposedFix: Add @Deprecated annotations and Javadoc notes to ChildWorkflowOptions.Builder#setNamespace, ChildWorkflowOptions#getNamespace, and namespace setters/getters on external cancel/signal stub options with note about server 1.30.1 disabling cross-namespace operations by default.
keyQuote: Cross-namespace operations are disabled by default as of server 1.30.1.
